arguments.cmd:
python3 -c "
import numpy as np, trimesh
from cadverify.cadcheck.mesh import load_exact
from cadverify.cadcheck import section
from cadverify.cadcheck.assembly import overlap
w = load_exact('checks/assembly/model.assembly.1d428528.stl')
b = load_exact('checks/assembly/model.assembly.57cfb177.stl')
sw = section.to_manifold(w); sb = section.to_manifold(b)
M = trimesh.transformations.rotation_matrix(np.radians(-17), [0,0,1], [0,0,4])
print('M dtype', M.dtype, 'C-contig', M.flags)
a = sw.transform(M[:3,:])
print('a vol', a.volume(), 'overlap(solid,other)...')
print('overlap fn:', overlap(a, sb))
inter = a ^ sb
print('direct vol', inter.volume(), 'area', inter.surface_area())
print('2V/A =', 2*inter.volume()/inter.surface_area())
"
